text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, El Condor Pasa
comes running
up to me as I'm making
my way to the academy.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sí! I got up with the sun today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm ridin' high and shiny just like the
sun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Watch out, Trainer, or you might get
burned!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The flames of passion are burnin' outta
control!
